---
title: "Map of 5 data collection areas in Madagascar "
output: html_document
date: "2024-02-07"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r echo = FALSE}
world <- map_data("world")

worldplot <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = world, aes(x=long, y = lat, group = group), fill = "grey")+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(30, 60), ylim = c(-30, -10)) +
  labs(title = "Malagasy data sources", x= "Longitude", y = "Latitude")

# Took a kml from google maps 
kml_data <- st_read(dsn = resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/test_map.kml"))

worldplot + geom_sf(data = kml_data, color = "darkblue", fill = "transparent", size = 1) + coord_sf(xlim = c(30, 60), ylim = c(-30, -10))




```
